brief.headline: Push for ₹66.48/KG to match Sayaji's price and save ₹1.26 Cr a year — their 8.5% profit margin gives them room to move.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹66.48/KG, the price Sayaji Industries gives us for the same Dextrose.
priceAsk.target: ₹66.48/KG (closes the 3.0% gap and saves ₹1.26 Cr per year)
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji for identical material. Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP sit in a ₹60–81/kg band, typically ₹66–73/kg, so our target sits right in the middle of fair market range. Their price of ₹68.45/KG is costing us ₹1.26 Cr extra every year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed.

brief.financialLeverage: They keep 8.5% of every rupee they sell as profit and another 11.7% as operating profit before interest and tax — comfortable cushions that give them room to cut price without real pain. They carry very little debt (0.13x) so money is not tight for them. We are 0.35% of their ₹5995.63 Cr revenue — a small customer, which means we have less sway on our own but can still push hard on price because we have Sayaji and three other credible alternates lined up.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹68.45/KG but Sayaji charges us only ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
Closing that 3.0% gap saves us ₹1.26 Cr every year
They keep 8.5% of sales as profit — enough cushion to give us a better price
We spend ₹21.21 Cr with them but that is only 0.35% of their ₹5995.63 Cr revenue
Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our ₹66.48/KG target sits in the fair zone
evidence.figure: marketAsk askBand: ₹60–81/kg, typical: ₹66–73/kg, verdict: MARKET-FAIR (slightly favourable)

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed starch and polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — described as a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja and Sayaji for dextrose.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist making starch and dextrose, ₹821.13 Cr revenue, health score C (53/100), growing capacity.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed Indore maize wet-miller, ₹365.39 Cr revenue, makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS in IV-fluid grade — exact form match (confirm IP monograph certificate of analysis before switching).

risks: They supply 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) — our main source. Pushing too hard without a qualified second supplier in place leaves us exposed if they walk or cut us off.
We are only 0.35% of their business, so losing us does not hurt them much. Anchor the ask to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG price and the market band, not to our volume.
Their health score is C (55/100) — mid-range. Not distressed, but watch for any supply hiccups and move fast to qualify Gulshan or Sanstar as backup.
Three of the backup leads (Tirupati health D 27/100, Roquette India health D 28/100, and two with no health data) need careful vetting before we can lean on them in negotiation.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, and today we want to talk about matching the ₹66.48/KG that Sayaji gives us for the same Dextrose — it would save us ₹1.26 Cr a year and keep us competitive.
